scripts.bundle: ([ -f .env.local ] && set -a && . ./.env.local && set +a) || true; OUTFILE="${CLI_BUNDLE_OUTFILE:-./dist/donut-cli.bundle.mjs}"; pnpm exec esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile="$OUTFILE" --format=esm --conditions=mineru-bundle --loader:.py=text --alias:donut-api=../packages/donut-api/src/index.ts --alias:react-devtools-core=./src/shims/react-devtools-core-stub.ts --alias:react=./node_modules/react --alias:react/jsx-runtime=./node_modules/react/jsx-runtime.js --banner:js="$(printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\nimport { createRequire } from "module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);')" --define:CLI_VERSION=\"${CLI_VERSION:-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")}\" --define:process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\"${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:-}\" --define:process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\"${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET:-}\" --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\"
scripts.test:mineru-python: python3 -c "import unittest,sys; s=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('python','test_*.py'); r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(s); sys.exit(0 if r.wasSuccessful() else 1)"
